positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationVerificationStatus
positions.frame: What is the verification status of the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration at 88.4 MHz?
positions.why: src-1 (narrative prose) and src-3 (structured label) restate the same verification event — calibrated at 88.4 MHz, checked against the June reference plates, holding across the band — in two different documentary registers (running assertion vs. field entry). Both carry the same directional read: settled, unhedged, expert confirmation (matter-of-fact register, present/realis/concrete temporal, competence value, expert-informational power). Grouping them lets the pair be read as one verified-status claim rather than two independent facts; no tension between them, just restatement in different forms.
